# The server binary (go build -cover ./cmd/server) booted on a fresh
# database with one malformed setting, and how it refused to start (refactor
# plan §6.4 S4b; invariant I13). Written by TestBootMisconfigured
# (cmd/server/boot_misconfigured_test.go) through the S4a harness
# (cmd/server/harness_test.go); the server's HTTP_PROXY and HTTPS_PROXY are
# the test's recording proxy, which refuses everything. Regenerate with
#   OPENV_TEST_DATABASE_URL=<server URL> UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./cmd/server -count=1 -run '^TestBootMisconfigured$'
# against a server with or without the vector extension.
# Normalised: log timestamps dropped; durations, ports, the release version,
# UUIDs and the temporary directory replaced by <...>; a no-vector server's
# warning taken out; the recording proxy's address shown as <recording proxy
# port>; lines logged from boot goroutines left out.

== misconfigured boot fatal_billing_trial_days: OPENV_BILLING_TRIAL_DAYS with a unit after the number, with no STRIPE_SECRET_KEY (billing off)
HTTPS_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:<recording proxy port>
HTTP_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:<recording proxy port>
OPENV_BILLING_TRIAL_DAYS=30d

== boot log, in order (lines logged from boot goroutines left out)
level=INFO msg="using DATABASE_URL (Railway.app mode)"
level=INFO msg="workspace limits configured" self_hosted=false default_plan=single overrides=0
level=INFO msg="upload sweep: nothing to remove: the database names no figure or evidence file, and <tmp>/uploads holds none"
level=INFO msg="embeddings: OPENV_EMBEDDING_API_KEY unset; semantic-search embedding disabled (create/update and existing search are unaffected)"
level=INFO msg="transient runners disabled (set RUNNER_POOL_KEY to enable)"
level=INFO msg="Hosted runners disabled (HOSTED_RUNNERS=off)"
level=INFO msg="shared product pool seeded" added=15 of=15
level=INFO msg="email: OPENV_SMTP_HOST unset; email notifications disabled (in-app + SSE delivery unaffected)"
level=INFO msg="email verification: disabled (no OPENV_SMTP_HOST; accounts are verified at sign-up)"
level=INFO msg="session lifetime" max_age=720h0m0s idle=168h0m0s
level=INFO msg="registration: open (set OPENV_REGISTRATION=closed to require an invitation)"
level=INFO msg="push: OPENV_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY unset; web push disabled (in-app + SSE delivery unaffected)"
level=INFO msg=release version=<version>
level=ERROR msg="billing configuration is not usable" error="OPENV_BILLING_TRIAL_DAYS must be a whole number of days, got \"30d\""

== stdout
(none)

== exit
exit status 1
the server exited before it answered /health

== the boot's database after the exit
migrations ran before the exit: in part (the schema_migrations ledger holds 55 versions, 1 to 56)

== outbound requests (the recording proxy, after exit)
none: the server sent no request through HTTP_PROXY or HTTPS_PROXY
